title: HtmlProgress
responsibility: Renders the native progress element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlProgress.attributes
inputs.description: Native progress attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlProgress.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native progress element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlProgress
outputs.description: The actual native progress element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
